finding.summary: F6 lacked a committed engine-neutral local inference/evaluation boundary. A loopback-default OpenAI-compatible adapter plus seven Frank-specific behavioral baseline cases and regression test are now committed in the Frank repository. This establishes the measurement contract without selecting a model, quantization or inference engine.

external_research.finding: Official Qwen3.5-4B supports current serving paths including OpenAI-compatible local service interfaces; exact target-host runtime/quantization must still be measured.
Qwen3-4B remains a useful mature 4B-class text baseline/fallback for comparative Frank evaluation.
Current Qwen3.5-4B/GGUF compatibility has live upstream issue evidence; llama.cpp must therefore be benchmarked/verified rather than assumed as the production engine.

adapter_contract: loopback endpoint allowed by default; remote endpoint requires explicit allow
no environment/API-key/secret-store reads in baseline adapter
durable receipt contains visible answer/tool calls/usage only; no separate hidden reasoning field

sandbox_regression.meaning: The adapter/evaluator contract is internally coherent. No real Qwen inference, target-host memory/latency measurement or model quality claim follows from the mock receipt.

feedback.frank: Use the committed F6 suite as the minimum baseline before any model/fine-tune promotion.
feedback.harness: Keep model behavior measurable through externally visible outputs and state/effect receipts; never make hidden reasoning a release dependency.
feedback.unifieddb: Injected current-state use must be tested by nonce/state facts and later real state capsules, not by self-report.
feedback.claycode: Structured Clay-native output and proposal-only authority remain explicit eval obligations independent of engine.
feedback.clay: Preserve engine neutrality until target-device measurements discriminate model/runtime choices.

next_discriminating_work: obtain fresh F5 target-device/body receipts under repo_truth_gate PASS
run Qwen3.5-4B through a current compatible local OpenAI-compatible serving path when target hardware permits
run Qwen3-4B as a stable 4B-class comparison where feasible
measure latency, tokens/s, peak RAM/VRAM, context scaling, restart behavior and all seven Frank cases
record engine/model/quantization selection or explicit NO_SELECTION
do not fine-tune before baseline runtime/model evidence exists
